input_messages.content: Hi there! I’m having trouble with my mobile data—it either stops working or is extremely slow. I really need to get excellent internet speed on my phone, especially since I don’t have access to Wi-Fi right now. Can you help me fix this?
Sure! My name is John Smith and my phone number is 555-123-2002. Let me know if you need any more information to verify my account.
The issue is happening on my phone, which uses the number 555-123-2002. That’s the line I’m having trouble with.

My phone is connected to the cellular network with excellent signal strength, and it’s on 5G. Mobile data is enabled, airplane mode is off, and I’m not connected to Wi-Fi. Data roaming is currently off. What should I try next?

Here’s what I found on my phone:
- Data Saver mode is off.
- VPN is turned off.
- The network mode preference is set to 4G/5G preferred.

What should I try next?
My SIM card is active and working properly. What would you like me to check next?
My current APN name is set to "internet" and the MMSC URL is "http://mms.carrier.com/mms/wapenc." Do these settings look correct, or should I try resetting them to default?
Yes, please guide me through resetting the APN settings to default and rebooting the device. I’m ready to follow your instructions.

I followed your instructions and reset the APN settings to default, then rebooted my phone. However, after restarting, my mobile data isn’t working at all now—I can’t even run a speed test because there’s no connection. What should I do next?
Mobile data is currently enabled on my phone, according to the status bar. Would you still like me to try toggling it off and on again, or is there something else I should check?

I toggled mobile data off and then back on again, but unfortunately, my mobile data connection is still not working—I can’t run a speed test because there’s no connection at all. What should I try next?
I checked again, and Data Saver mode is off. There don’t appear to be any background data restrictions enabled on my phone. Is there anything else I should try?
Yes, I am currently abroad in France, so I might need data roaming enabled. Please assist me with checking and enabling roaming if necessary.
I enabled data roaming on my phone, but I still don’t have a mobile data connection—I’m unable to run a speed test because there’s no connection at all. What should I do next?
I tried again, but my mobile data connection is still not working—there’s still no connection, and I can’t run a speed test. What else can we try?
My current network mode preference is set to "4g_5g_preferred." Is there anything else I should check or try adjusting?
